name: Method
question: Does the paper use this method to collect or analyze its data?

labels.name: survey
labels.definition: Questionnaire data from a sample of respondents.

labels.name: experiment
labels.definition: A lab, field or online experiment with manipulated conditions.

labels.name: panel / econometrics
labels.definition: Archival, secondary or panel data analyzed with regression or econometric models.

labels.name: SEM / PLS
labels.definition: Structural equation modeling, covariance-based or PLS-SEM.

labels.name: case study
labels.definition: Single or multiple case study design.

labels.name: interviews
labels.definition: Semi-structured or in-depth interviews as a main data source.

labels.name: ethnography
labels.definition: Extended observation or participant observation in the field.

labels.name: grounded theory
labels.definition: Grounded theory coding and theory building (Glaser and Strauss, Charmaz).

labels.name: Gioia
labels.definition: The Gioia methodology: first-order concepts, second-order themes, aggregate dimensions.

labels.name: QCA
labels.definition: Qualitative comparative analysis: crisp-set or fuzzy-set (fsQCA).

labels.name: simulation
labels.definition: Agent-based, system dynamics or other computational simulation.

labels.name: bibliometric
labels.definition: Citation, co-citation, co-word or other bibliometric analysis of publications.

labels.name: content analysis
labels.definition: Systematic coding of texts, documents or media, qualitative or quantitative.
